(app_private.has_staff_role(ARRAY['super_admin'::text, 'admin'::text, 'discipleship_admin'::text, 'content_admin'::text]) OR ((status = 'active'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (((lessons content_lesson
     JOIN courses content_course ON ((content_course.id = content_lesson.course_id)))
     JOIN course_enrollments ce ON (((ce.profile_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (ce.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'completed'::text])))))
     JOIN courses enrolled_course ON ((enrolled_course.id = ce.course_id)))
  WHERE ((content_lesson.id = lesson_assets.lesson_id) AND (content_course.status = 'published'::text) AND ((content_course.id = enrolled_course.id) OR ((content_course.translation_key IS NOT NULL) AND (content_course.translation_key = enrolled_course.translation_key))))))))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) <= 300)))
